title: The waiting page lets you clear an answer or say "none of these"
why: Your gripe, Oct 26 (waiting page, item 27): you could not unselect an answer, and none of the three options was right.
note: Pilot fixed Oct 26 by the waiting-page thread (version 3, https://claude.ai/artifact/9PJB2skRSMtCC4XHvzbmB8; source plans/c71-waiting-page.html in project files): every decision has a "None of these" option that needs a note saying what you want instead, and every item has a Clear button that removes the draft or the saved answer; the answer line reads "N none of these (note)". claude-settings part, one cloud lane, needs no answer from you: the waiting-page skill (c71, PR #636, on main 54be9f1) gives its page template the same two controls, and its session protocol treats a "none" answer as a request for new options, never as a ruling, and a cleared answer as no answer. Port: yes, every repo's page comes from the skill. Placed after c80, ahead of c76 (triage, Oct 26): the page is how every deferred step reaches you, and a wrong forced pick becomes a false ruling.
